bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement. Every class carries a discriminator written BEFORE any of them run, and the one KILLED class names the landed receipt that killed it. Maximum payoffs are None because none has been bounded yet, and a null is honest where a number would be invented.

classes.cheapest_discriminator: build the single-token dependency DAG and count edges that are NOT true data dependencies; any artificial barrier is schedulable slack
classes.claim: the executor orders independent work serially, so one stream under-fills the machine that two streams fill
classes.killed_by: receipts/future/SINGLE_TOKEN_PARALLEL_SLACK.json: 11 edges, 11 true dependencies, 0 artificial barriers, 0 unknown, theoretically_overlapable_ns = 0. gate/up/swiglu, q/k/v, residual/rmsnorm and ba_to_decay are ALREADY fused, so the reorderable slack was taken, not left.
classes.kills_if: every edge in the token is a true data dependency and the independent operations are already fused
classes.reopens_if: a representation change creates new independence, or a region is found that the DAG did not model

classes.cheapest_discriminator: sweep threadgroup size and grid on ONE production matvec at fixed bytes and fixed arithmetic; if effective GB/s rises with occupancy alone the class is live
classes.claim: the decode kernels launch too little parallel work to keep the memory system busy; a second stream supplies the missing waves
classes.kills_if: GB/s is flat across a real occupancy sweep at identical bytes
classes.reopens_if: a kernel is changed in a way that alters its register or threadgroup footprint

classes.cheapest_discriminator: unroll the per-thread load stride on one matvec so each thread issues N independent loads before consuming any; bytes and arithmetic identical, output bit-identical
classes.claim: each thread has too few independent loads in flight, so latency is exposed rather than hidden; independent streams interleave
classes.kills_if: deeper per-thread load pipelining does not move GB/s
classes.reopens_if: the representation changes the access pattern

classes.cheapest_discriminator: the matched ARM A pair already built: bytes identical, arithmetic stripped. If stripping arithmetic moves the time, the chain is arithmetic-bound
classes.claim: the decode inner loop is a serial FMA/decode chain, so ALU latency rather than memory is the stall
classes.kills_if: ARM A (arithmetic stripped, bytes identical) does not move meaningfully faster than production
classes.reopens_if: a representation with a longer decode chain is proposed
classes.sharpened_by: receipts/future/MLP_ALU_ROOFLINE.json. ARM A strips the arithmetic at IDENTICAL BYTES and MLP goes 329.6 -> 497.4 GB/s, a 1.5089x jump; DeltaNet qkvz goes 600.9 -> 943.2, 1.5697x. ARM B halves K and returns time/byte 1.0427 - bytes behave like bytes. The pre-registered rule reads that conjunction as MIXED: both terms are real. So this class is NOT killed and NOT alone. What it now carries is a NUMBER: about 1.5x is available at constant bytes, which sits inside the 1.24-1.60x the concurrency ladder measured from a completely different direction. Two independent probes, one magnitude. SELF_MEASURED_DIRTY and taken under load 8.41, so the ABSOLUTE GB/s are not promotable - but ARM A is a back-to-back RATIO at identical bytes, and ratios hold under load.

classes.cheapest_discriminator: read the compiled pipeline's register footprint and max threads per threadgroup from the Metal reflection, then compare against the occupancy sweep in class B
classes.claim: register pressure caps resident waves per core below what the memory system needs
classes.kills_if: the achieved threadgroup size is already at the device maximum and occupancy is not the binding term
classes.reopens_if: a kernel rewrite changes the register footprint

classes.cheapest_discriminator: vary only the per-launch working-set size at constant bytes and constant arithmetic and look for a knee
classes.claim: one stream's working set thrashes a level that two interleaved streams happen to use better
classes.kills_if: no knee appears across a working-set sweep spanning the plausible cache sizes

classes.cheapest_discriminator: the same token issued across two command queues versus one, identical kernels and identical order, token output bit-identical
classes.claim: one command queue or one encoder serialises submission in a way two processes escape
classes.kills_if: multiple queues do not change GPU time for identical work
classes.reopens_if: the driver or OS scheduler changes

classes.cheapest_discriminator: run the SAME kernel at batch>1 on synthetic input and compare GB/s per byte moved against the batch-1 rate
classes.claim: the decode shapes (batch 1, one row block) leave the kernel's own tiling underfilled regardless of occupancy
classes.kills_if: per-byte rate is flat from batch 1 upward
classes.reopens_if: a batched or speculative decode path is adopted

classes.cheapest_discriminator: this class exists to be SPLIT, not tested: it is the parent of B, C, D, E and F and must be replaced by one of them before any payoff is claimed
classes.claim: something is exposing latency that a second stream hides, without yet saying which latency
classes.kills_if: one of its children is confirmed, which makes the parent redundant rather than false
classes.reopens_if: every child is killed and the effect survives

summary.do_not_call_it_serial_dependency: concurrency helping is the OBSERVATION, not the cause. Class H - the one that would have made 'serial dependency' literally true at the dispatch grain - is the one class already dead. What remains is inside the kernels, and naming it before measuring would be the error this tree exists to prevent.
